description: Picks ONE Plot Speaks story or game to play now, ranked from the player's mood, the time they have, how many are playing and an optional collection, skipping what a signed-in player has already played. Returns the pick's title, slug and one-line pitch, plus a runner-up. Records only anonymous counts of the mood matched and length asked for. If nothing fits every filter it says so instead of picking.

all_ages.description: True to keep it suitable for every age (nothing rated above PG)

collection.description: Only from this collection, by name or id: Murder Mysteries, Greek Myths, Classic Detectives, Horror and Ghosts, Seasons, Holiday Specials, Bedtime, Dice Games, Road Trip, Read-Aloud Classics, Written by players

mood.description: The mood or kind of thing, in their words, e.g. spooky, light, a mystery, something calm

name: pick_for_me
title: Pick something for me
